verses.text: Jehovah, how are mine adversaries increased! Many are they that rise up against me.

segments.text: Jehovah, how are mine adversaries increased!
Many are they that rise up against me.

verses.text: Many there are that say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. [Selah

segments.text: Many there are that say of my soul,
There is no help for him in God. [Selah

verses.text: But thou, O Jehovah, art a shield about me; My glory, and the lifter up of my head.

segments.text: But thou, O Jehovah, art a shield about me;
My glory, and the lifter up of my head.

verses.text: I cry unto Jehovah with my voice, And he answereth me out of his holy hill. [Selah

segments.text: I cry unto Jehovah with my voice,
And he answereth me out of his holy hill. [Selah

verses.text: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for Jehovah sustaineth me.

segments.text: I laid me down and slept;
I awaked; for Jehovah sustaineth me.

verses.text: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of the people That have set themselves against me round about.

segments.text: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of the people
That have set themselves against me round about.

verses.text: Arise, O Jehovah; save me, O my God: For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.

segments.text: Arise, O Jehovah; save me, O my God:
For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone;
Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.

verses.text: Salvation belongeth unto Jehovah: Thy blessing be upon thy people. [Selah

segments.text: Thy blessing be upon thy people. [Selah

headings.text: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.
